digest:
Feature: the peer interviewer. With PEER_INTERVIEWER_ENABLED (default off) the session graph also acts as a senior engineer beside the interviewer. Everything it produces is advice for the interviewer, delivered as copilot cards on one websocket channel (copilot_card), plus a rubric coverage map (copilot_coverage), a live scorecard (scorecard) and answers to typed questions (copilot_reply).

Facts (checked in the code):
- build_session_graph(failover, session_id, agentic, peer). Peer mode uses the fan-out shape even when AGENTIC_ROUTING_ENABLED is off; agentic actions are offered to the analysis only when that flag is on. Peer actions offered: suggest_probe, verify_claim, clarify, edge_cases. The analysis prompt is byte-identical to today's when no actions are offered.
- Card kinds: probe, claim_check, clarification, coaching, pace, stuck, difficulty, edge_cases. Priorities info/suggest/urgent. source is llm or rule. Card id is '<session>:<utterance or snapshot or question>:<kind>' so a resumed run re-sending a card is deduped on the dashboard.
- LLM calls: suggest_probes, verify_claim, draft_clarification, suggest_edge_cases use TaskType.PEER_INTERVIEWER (Sonnet). coach_interviewer uses TaskType.INTERVIEWER_COACHING (claude-haiku-5-5). answer_copilot_query uses TaskType.COPILOT_QUERY (Sonnet) through run_tool_loop, max 4 steps. Every peer node wraps the call in retry_transient and a 20 s timeout (ACTION_TIMEOUT_S); failures log peer_action_failed and emit nothing; the run is never failed by a peer action.
- Triggers: probes run when the analysis chose suggest_probe OR key_points_missed is non-empty. Clarification runs when chosen OR looks_like_a_question(text) ('?' or starts with can i assume / should i / do you want / is it okay if). Claim check runs only when chosen; a card appears only for verdict incorrect/misleading with confidence ≥ 0.6. Edge cases run when chosen OR the code graph lists bugs, and only once per code snapshot id (edge_cases_for).
- Coaching: interviewer final turns of ≥ 12 words, at most one call per 20 s of interview time (last_coaching_at). Rule signals with no model: monologue (one interviewer turn ≥ 120 words) and talk share (interviewer ≥ 60% of words over the last 40 utterances, once ≥ 250 words were spoken, at most one nudge per 5 min).
- Clock: the pipeline enqueues Tick(at) every 30 s (TICK_INTERVAL_S) when the flag is on; replay and tests call on_tick directly. Pace: elapsed since QuestionChanged.at (or the first utterance) against question_plan.time_minutes × 60; alerts at 100% (suggest) and 150% (urgent), each once per question; the card quotes remaining_questions and remaining_minutes that the dashboard now sends with change_question. Stuck: code graph is_stuck AND candidate quiet ≥ 60 s AND snapshot not yet handled → stuck card and a Send to the existing draft_hint node (Smart Hints suggestion).
- After every recorded analysis (no model): coverage_increments adds evidence per report criterion (problem_solving always; communication when dimensions exist; hint_responsiveness when hint_reception exists; behavioral on signals/flags or behavioral category; system_design for that category; code_quality for coding with code present); status none/thin/solid with solid at 3; resume_verification counts claimed experience + contradictions. scorecard_notes_from_analysis adds a note with a 200-char quote (and a red-flags note). difficulty_signal over the last 3 scored analyses: cruising (all ≥ 4 and on track) or struggling (≥ 2 weak or ≥ 2 direct hints), once per key per question; the card lists the plan's alternates.
- Interviewer actions: use_copilot_card → CopilotCardUsed → copilot_cards_used (max 50, deduped) → report. add_scorecard_note → ScorecardNoteAdded → interviewer_note (unknown criterion or empty text dropped) → scorecard (max 60) → send_scorecard. Dismiss and mute are browser-only; mutes live in localStorage key copilot_muted_kinds.
- Ask the copilot: handle_copilot_query is awaited inline in the dashboard websocket loop (same as rate_code and request_runtime_hint). live_evidence_index builds the report's EvidenceIndex from live values: transcript entries T1..Tn, analyses, code timeline, contradictions, hints, facts, summary, scorecard notes. Tools: search_transcript, read_transcript, get_analyses, get_code_timeline, get_contradictions, get_hints, and get_scorecard_notes only when notes exist. Citations are kept only for real entry ids; a quote that does not match the entry is blanked. The handler never raises: errors come back as {answer: 'Copilot unavailable: …', error}.
- Report: report_snapshot adds copilot_cards_used and scorecard_notes; ReportInput gets scorecard_notes and copilot_usage; _build_context adds '## Interviewer Scorecard Notes' (all interviewer notes, last 20 copilot drafts with quotes) and '## Copilot Suggestions The Interviewer Used' (counts per kind, plus the line that relayed probes count as the interviewer's questions). Agentic scoring (REPORT_AGENTIC_SCORING) gets the get_scorecard_notes tool when notes exist.
- Frontend: copilot-store keeps the 20 newest cards, dedupes by id, remembers used ids, mutes per kind; CopilotPanel sits at the top of the right column of LiveSessionPage; 'Mark as asked' for probe/clarification/claim_check/edge_cases, 'Done' for the rest. The frontend has no signal for the flag: the panel renders and says 'Listening.' even when the flag is off.

Decisions taken: one flag for all of it; deterministic signals also run only under the flag; coaching on a light model; the panel is a full dashboard UI, not a toast; cards are one payload shape on one channel; peer actions never fail a run.

Open questions: hide the panel when the flag is off (needs a backend signal); send mutes to the backend so muted kinds skip their model calls; run copilot_query as a task so the websocket loop is not blocked; avoid a checkpoint write on every 30 s tick when nothing is due; a cheap trigger for claim checks beyond the analysis choosing it; which model for the Sonnet peer calls.

Tests: tests/test_peer_signals.py (unit), tests/test_peer_report.py (unit), tests/test_peer_interviewer.py (Postgres replay), apps/frontend/src/__tests__/copilot.test.tsx. Backend suite 448 passed with the same 10 pre-existing failures as before; frontend 96 passed.
